title: The Last Spire Revisited
author: Ines Blackwood
blurb: Wendell Kavanagh, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
